name: Acceptance stream B
description: The acceptance run's streams fixture, the provider (§5.4 "Streams"): in a host process of its own, it fills acceptance-stream-a's point `acceptance-stream-a.sounds` with a handler that answers with a stream of generated bytes. Its `nosy` command tries to open a stream to a half of acceptance-stream-a, which is refused.

commands.name: nosy
commands.description: Tries to open a stream to a page of its own, which has none, and to write to another plugin's stream.
